rows.note: This is the all-purpose directional choice after a verb for moving or sending something away, including beyond a boundary.

example.jyutping: faai3 di1 zoeng1 go3 bo1 tek3 ceot1 heoi3 laa1

rows.note: Use this when something comes out toward the speaker or becomes visible or available, including speaking or shouting out and bringing something into view.

example.english: They finally blurted the whole story out.
example.traditional: 佢終於將件事講咗出嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 zoeng1 gin6 si6 gong2 zo2 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for being or doing something outside, including eating away from home rather than at home.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 ceot1 min6 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this after a verb when the action is carried through to the end, as in asking someone to let you finish speaking.

example.english: Hear me out and let me finish speaking; I still have more to say.
example.traditional: 你等我講完先啦，我仲有嘢要講。
example.jyutping: nei5 dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 sin1 laa1 ngo5 zung6 jau5 je5 jiu3 gong2
